author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a smooth round-ended capsule at 45 degrees with a centre divider, and a round tablet with a diagonal score, the two separated by a clear gap; reads as medicine pills.
omissions: The capsule is slightly shorter than in the source so the tablet keeps a full clearance gap; the tablet's score runs at about 49 degrees rather than exactly 45 so its ends land on integer knots of a round tablet.
drawing_plan: Circular cubic arcs about integer centres; capsule caps A=(12,20)/B=(20,12) with a mid divider, tablet centre (33,33) r9 with a diametral score.
